question: 按性别统计 2015 年佣金收入，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT dc.Gender AS gender, SUM(ft.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer dc ON ft.SK_CustomerID = dc.SK_CustomerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2015 GROUP BY dc.Gender ORDER BY commission_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 佣金是经纪服务收取的费用
Gender 是客户（自然人）属性
佣金按证券交易事件记录
